# Local Three.js distribution

Three.js 0.187.0, MIT license (LICENSE.txt), copied without modification from the
exact npm dependency recorded in package-lock.json. Browser module dependencies
are served locally; loading Robot does not contact a CDN or asset service.

Reproduce with `npm ci` then `npm run vendor:embodiment` from the repository root.
Original robot geometry, poses and UI are authored in the parent directory.
